prompt: Why does the man ask about the side entrance?

options.text: He is expecting a large delivery.
options.whyZh: 送貨司機只是地圖的額外受益者。

options.text: The main doors have been repainted.
options.whyZh: 油漆設備在走廊，未說正門上漆。

options.text: An interview applicant asked about step-free access.
options.zh: 有一位應徵者詢問有沒有無階梯通道。
options.whyZh: 男子為應徵者確認無階梯通道。

options.text: Visitors are not permitted in the lobby.

explanationZh: 男子為應徵者確認無階梯通道。
evidence: One applicant has asked about step-free access.

vocabulary.note: 讓不方便使用階梯的人進出。
